summary: Phase-4 features (OTP MOCK, WebAuthn passkeys, Video KYC, PDF+Excel statements) fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass — 13 new (test_phase4_features.py) + 9 regression (test_new_features.py including 7-role login, exact 3-card seed, UPI status/link/QR, all role panels + RBAC, brute-force lockout at 6th attempt). Frontend: retail sidebar now correctly shows Statements/Video KYC/Security & Passkeys tabs. Statements page renders account picker (1 pre-selected account SBI00984521098), all 4 quick-range chips (7/30/90/365) — clicking 'Last 30 days' correctly sets From date to 2026-08-10, From/To date pickers, and green Excel + red PDF download buttons with proper data-testid download-pdf-btn / download-excel-btn. Security page shows Passkeys section with empty-state message, Register-passkey button, and OTP demo panel — selecting Email + Login purpose and clicking Send OTP successfully displays the amber 'Demo mode:' box with the 6-digit OTP. Video KYC page shows Selfie→PAN→Aadhaar progress with vkyc-step-selfie highlighted (bg-#0b3b8c) plus Start Camera button and preview panel. Admin (manager.sbi) sidebar shows Video KYC Queue tab; clicking it renders 'Video KYC Verification Queue' header with Pending list and empty right pane. Passkey-login-btn present on auth modal. No blocking issues. Statement 'wrong account' correctly returns 404 for both PDF and Excel. Video KYC invalid frame validation works. OTP verified-twice returns 'No active OTP.'; wrong OTP returns 'Invalid OTP.'. Admin approve on submitted Video KYC updates user.kyc_status='verified'. All previously reported cosmetic issues (orange in RuPay/Mastercard gradient, UPI tab badge text) are out of scope for this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2202 lines with 4 different feature domains bolted onto the tail (OTP, WebAuthn, Video KYC, Statements). Strong candidate for splitting into /app/backend/routers/{otp,passkeys,kyc_video,statements}.py for maintainability.

Video KYC endpoint caps each base64 field at 400,000 chars via slicing (server.py L2006-2008). For a 640x480 JPEG this is fine, but if the browser uploads a 1080p PNG the truncation would silently corrupt the image and admin review would see broken thumbnails — consider explicit 413 rejection instead of silent truncation, or increase to 1.5MB.

PASSKEY_LOGIN audit log writes hard-coded ip='0.0.0.0' (server.py L1966) and VIDEO_KYC_SUBMITTED same (L2021). Should use request.client.host with X-Forwarded-For fallback for consistency with brute-force fix.

OTP demo_otp is exposed unconditionally whenever LIVE_OTP != 'true' (server.py L1815). Fine for demo, but the docstring/response should more prominently flag 'DEMO MODE — do not deploy without setting LIVE_OTP=true and rotating Twilio/SendGrid keys'.

Statement PDF/Excel endpoints do not paginate and .to_list(500) hard-caps rows — for a busy corporate account with >500 txns the statement will be silently truncated. Add a 'note: statement truncated to last 500 rows' banner or use streaming pagination.
SecurityPage.js b64uToBuf / bufToB64u helpers are re-implemented per page — extract to /src/utils/webauthn.js so passkey login on AuthPage doesn't duplicate the logic.
VideoKycPage.js starts camera via getUserMedia and only stops on unmount — if the user navigates away via sidebar (not unmount), the camera stream may persist. Consider stopping on route change/blur.

Passkey delete endpoint returns 404 correctly, but there is no rate-limit / MFA on delete — a stolen session cookie could silently strip all passkeys. Consider requiring fresh OTP or password re-entry before delete.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (retail 3 new pages + admin queue + auth passkey button all verified)

test_credentials: All 7 seeded accounts still login. Retail rahul.sharma@example.com used for OTP/passkey/kyc/statements; admin manager.sbi@example.com used for kyc queue + decision.
seed_data_creation: test_phase4_features::TestVideoKyc submits one video KYC and admin approves it -> user.kyc_status flips 'verified'. To reset for another test run, remove the doc from db.kyc_video_submissions or expect the retail user's kyc_status to be 'verified' at start (test itself submits fresh so idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase-4 endpoints are green under /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_features.py. Backend runs pytest via `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v`. WebAuthn actual credential.create() was NOT tested (impossible in headless Playwright); only the challenge/list/delete-404/no-passkey paths were tested. If the next agent needs to test complete passkey enroll, they'll need to mock navigator.credentials or use a virtual authenticator via CDP.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Only one flaky test-time fix: the /api/auth/me endpoint wraps the user under a 'user' key (not flat); test assertion updated to look at data['user'].kyc_status.
